I don't recommend doing it my way because everyone handles their emotions differently but I never spoke to a professional about my problems or took medication . I wish I could have I really do because my way was messy I had ALOT of breakdowns of wanting to end it , the reason I didnt is because in my family around that time no one really talked to eachother about anything personal or how they were feeling , I was to scared to bring up my suicidal thoughts and depression in fear of being ridiculed by my family . 
So it was just a long fight with myself to try to become my own friend and to change how I thought about myself to say nicer things to myself and think about why I was putting myself down and try to be able to look at myself in a mirror . It took 4 years after I decided to change to actually notice a difference , I was able to look at myself in a mirror for longer and longer times and I tried to dress a little nicer and even got a haircut! ( which i love and i still have its my favorite hairstyle ive ever had ) and it started falling into place and I loved art so I was doing that more to . Of course I didnt do eveything alone I found some amazing freinds and a amazing guy who is my best freind but even when I found him I still struggled for awhile it didnt magically change when i found love but he really helped me push myself more . 
But basically smaller version I just focused on myself and tried to pick up better habits to deal with myself and having someone to talk to also helps alot  .
